fixes.issue: Fusion was classified for the dedicated server even though its supported environment and Rechiseled dependency are client-only.
fixes.repair: Changed Fusion 1.3.12 from both to client; client remains 235 JARs and server is now 202 JARs.

fixes.issue: Windows PowerShell could not resolve PSScriptRoot in maintenance-script parameter defaults.
fixes.repair: Deferred ProjectRoot and dependent defaults until after parameter binding in all affected scripts.

fixes.issue: The selected local Prism instance had its per-instance pre-launch command disabled/blank.
fixes.repair: Restored the escaped Packwiz bootstrap command and enabled command overrides after making a timestamped instance.cfg backup.

fixes.issue: A closed Windows console pipe could throw HostException 0xE9, terminate the restart supervisor, and leave stale process state.
fixes.repair: Made console output best-effort, persisted state before optional output, added process fingerprints, rejected recycled PIDs, detected unmanaged Java processes, and reconciled stale state only when no process/listener/lock remains.

fixes.issue: The end-to-end validator incorrectly required exactly two tolerated loot warnings even when the corrected pack emitted none.
fixes.repair: The validator now rejects unexpected loot-table warnings while allowing zero or only the explicitly tolerated legacy warning.
